newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MEPC REFINANCING FRN THROUGH CBA.
newsitem.headline: MEPC REFINANCING FRN THROUGH CBA.

text.p: British property group MEPC Plc is refinancing an outstanding floating rate note issue which is due to mature in September, lead manager Commonwealth Bank of Australia said.
The refinancing will be through MEPC's A$500 million medium term note programme which CBA established in 1994.
The original issue had been priced at 48 basis points over the bill rate and the issuer is looking at something substantially below that this time round, a CBA official said.
Given the maturity of the outstanding issue CBA will be bringing the issue to the market in late August or early September.
The issue, which will carry a guarantee from MEPC Plc and rated single A from Standard & Poor's Corp, will be around A$150 million and will likely be in an FRN structure.
CBA will be sole lead manager and other banks will be invited to the dealer panel.
